projection: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator, spherical, R = 6378137 m). Rows run north->south.
pixel_convention: area: every image spans exactly the bounds edge-to-edge.
snapped_to: zoom 7 tile-pixel grid (global px 4734..10558 x 11007..14283), 5824x3276 z7 px resampled to 4096x2304 (exact 16:9)

us_dark.note: dark stylised contiguous US: Census 1:5M states, Natural Earth 10m land/lakes for context, subtle relief from the terrain tiles

us_dark_montana.note: same with Montana highlighted (crimson fill, bright edge, soft outer glow)

montana_mask.note: 8-bit alpha mask of Montana (antialiased, 3x supersampled); white = Montana

montana_outline_mask.note: 8-bit mask of the Montana border line (~2.3 px wide)

us_heightmap.source: AWS Terrain Tiles (terrarium) z7, box-filtered to the render grid
us_heightmap.encoding: elevation_m = min_m + value / 65535 * (max_m - min_m); includes ocean bathymetry (negative) - clamp at 0 for a land-only relief
